// diagnostic

E1018

`{name}` is computed while building, but its value is a `{type}`, a runtime handle with no data form

What

`{name}` is computed while building, but its value is a `{type}`, a runtime handle with no data form

Why

A compile-time value must be data, which the build keeps and hands to later compile-time code and to the program. A runtime handle such as a `{type}` lives only in the run that made it.

Fix

Use the `{type}` inside one `#run`, such as a function it calls, and keep only the data that work returns.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1018: tests/ui/comptime_dependency_handle_value.stderr.
